_note: 2026 general-election candidates for State Senate and State House (Nevada: State Assembly) in Maine, Colorado, Minnesota and Nevada, read from each state's official candidate list on 2026-10-28. "rows" are new cmp-data.js candidate rows (candidate: true; they open no board). "alreadyHeld" are sitting legislators running for the seat they hold: their row is the roster row. "crossSeat" are sitting legislators running for a different legislative seat: their row is untouched and window.CMP_CANDIDACIES carries the candidacy. Withdrawn candidates and write-ins are excluded (see each state's note). Maine House 17 candidate Ronald B. Russell (ronald_b_russell_me) is not ME-1 candidate Ronald C. Russell (ronald_russell_me). Minnesota Senate 65 candidate Rocco is filed in the state feed as "_ Rocco" (nameAsFiled keeps that); the roster shows "Rocco".

me.note: Maine SOS '2026 General Candidate List - FINAL' (xlsx), office codes SS (State Senator) and SR (State Representative). maine.gov refuses automated requests, so the identical file was retrieved via its Wayback Machine capture of 2026-10-11, and the post-primary withdrawals and replacements PDF (updated 9/22/2026) via its capture of 2026-10-13. No candidate that PDF lists as withdrawn is on the xlsx; replacements are. Names composed First Middle Last Suffix from the file's separate columns; party is the file's code (D, R) or word (Independent, Unenrolled, Undeclared).

co.note: Colorado Secretary of State '2026 General Election Official Candidate List' (HTML table), State Senate and State House of Representatives entries. Excluded: Duane L Gurule (State Senate 35, struck through (withdrawn)); Isaac Contreras (State House of Representatives 16, certified write-in); Sherrea Sterling (State House of Representatives 17, certified write-in).

mn.note: Minnesota SOS election-results feed for the 11/3/2026 State General Election: State Senator (stsenate.txt) and State Representative (LegislativeByDistrict.txt) candidates, party names from PartyTbl.txt. The feed holds pre-election test vote counts, which were ignored. WRITE-IN placeholder rows excluded.

nv.note: Nevada Secretary of State '2026 General Election Statewide Certified List of Candidates' PDF, State Senate and State Assembly entries, retrieved via its Wayback Machine capture of 2026-10-01 (nvsos.gov is behind a bot wall). Names use the 'Candidate Name' column; no Note (withdrawn/deceased) flag on any legislative row.
